Based on the project structure, the coding assistant (Marin) provides the following tools:

**Core Functionality:**
- **Chat** (`crates/cli/src/chat.rs`) - Interactive conversation with the model
- **Code generation** (`crates/cli/src/code/`) - Code creation and manipulation
- **Model management** (`crates/model/`) - Model loading and configuration
- **Runtime** (`crates/runtime/`) - Execution environment
- **Sampling** (`crates/sampler/`) - Text generation control
- **Tensor operations** (`crates/tensor/`) - Numerical computations

**CLI Commands:**
- **Checkpoint** (`crates/cli/src/checkpoint.rs`) - Save/load model checkpoints
- **Session management** (`crates/cli/src/session/`) - Conversation history
- **Quality assessment** (`crates/cli/src/quality.rs`) - Evaluate outputs
- **Performance metrics** (`crates/cli/src/perf/`) - Benchmarking tools
- **Telemetry** (`crates/cli/src/telemetry.rs`) - Usage tracking
- **Server** (`crates/cli/src/server/`) - API server functionality

**Utilities:**
- **Memory management** (`crates/cli/src/memory.rs`)
- **Progress tracking** (`crates/cli/src/progress.rs`)
- **Trace/verification** (`crates/cli/src/trace.rs`)
- **Repl** (`crates/cli/src/repl.rs`) - Interactive shell

The tools are organized across multiple crates in `crates/` with the CLI interface in `crates/cli/`.
